structs.name: DB_DecompressState
structs.size_evidence: Not proven. Lower bound 583976: the last Replay access is encryptInfo qword at +583968 (DB_Block_TryNewBlock@0x140D89B90: mov r8,[rbx+8E920h]), so the state covers at least 583976. Upper bound 584064: the DB_AuthLoadReader chunk flag at +584064 (0x8E980) is read in DB_AsyncIWFileLoad_PumpDecodeQueue@0x140D87E40, CopyChainState, HasPendingWork, ResetDecodeState and RegisterHashCallback, and the state is the first member of that reader. The 88 bytes between 583976 and 584064 have no Replay access in the DB_* family (0x140D86B70-0x140D8A100) or the loader (0x1411A7000-0x1411A8400).
members: base address of the state: DB_CmpLoad_DumpState@0x140D8A000 prints currentUncompData = cmpLoadState; DB_Block_CopyFromUncompBuffer@0x140D89710: memcpy(stream.next_out, &a1->currentUncompData[ptr], n). Size not proven, see changed_members

structs.notes: Partial. The reader is the state: DB_AsyncIWFileLoad_Update@0x140D87470 takes v4 = *fileLoad (m_reader, offset 0 of DB_AsyncIWFileLoad) and passes it to PumpDecodeQueue and DB_CmpLoad_Decompress, so DB_DecompressState is at offset 0 of the reader. The reader size is 623488, proven (not 'at least'): DB_AsyncIWFileLoad_AcquireStreamerLoan@0x140D87250 has `mov edx, 98380h` (allocSize), `mov r8d, 80h` (alignment) and `mov [rbx], rax` (m_reader); DB_AsyncIWFileLoad::Shutdown@0x140D87760 frees m_reader with 623488. The reader's chunk (flag at 584064, 39416 bytes cleared by ResetDecodeState) follows the state. IDA's DB_AuthLoadReader is an opaque forward declaration (ordinal 4379); for the coordinator: it should be 623488 bytes with the state at 0 and a chunk at 584064 (not my range, proposal only). A113's front-unresolved point is now resolved: pending at 65536 and an Oodle scratch at 141312 with 442552 bytes. Do not apply the current IDA struct: it has the wrong front and no tail.
